summary.text: Jane Gillette is a Republican member of the Montana House of Representatives who has served since 2021 and now represents District 77; she is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A dentist and U.S. Air Force veteran, she served from 1999 to 2013.

paragraphs.text: Gillette earned a bachelor's degree in biology from Pacific Lutheran University in 1995, a doctorate in dental surgery from the University of Washington in 2002, and a master's degree in public health from the University of Montana in 2018.
She served in the U.S. Air Force from 1999 to 2013.
Her career experience includes working as dental director with Community Health Partners, a director with Sprout Oral Health, and owner of Mint Dental Studio.
Gillette lost the 2018 general election for House District 65 to Christopher Pope, then won District 64 in 2020 and 2022 and District 77 in 2024.
She was assigned to the Appropriations Committee in 2023-2024 and 2025-2026, and earlier served on the Human Services and Judiciary committees.
